row.title: A routine kept past its use
row.body: The arrangement is practical on its own; its careful order is the part no one explained.
row.rival_reading: Ordinary work leaves tools arranged this way; the unexplained step could be mundane rather than institutional.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
